postCreateCommand: pip install git+https://github.com/lucadealfaro/plainbook.git && pip install pandas matplotlib
postStartCommand: curl -L https://github.com/lucadealfaro/plainbook/raw/main/examples/Soccer.plnb -o /tmp/Soccer.plnb && nohup plainbook /tmp/Soccer.plnb > /tmp/plainbook.log 2>&1 & sleep 10 && grep 'Authentication token' /tmp/plainbook.log
